title: Makes the pickup code easy to check bit by bit
goal: Use a single-width font for the pickup code so that letters and numbers occupy the same width.
summary: font-family specifies the font family. monospace is a universal monospace font family. The browser will select the appropriate monospace font from the native font.
tasks: Select two pickup codes with pickup-code class.
Set the font-family of the pickup code to monospace without quotation marks, and retain the font of the cabinet name.

example.note: device registration page can use a fixed-width font for the device number, making it easier to check characters one by one.

hint: Check whether monospace is quoted. After adding quotes, the browser will look for it as a specific font family name.
